classes.content: Selected sales rows, dates, category/member labels and measures, explicit comparison windows, calculated current/prior values and changes, complete source tables, context and chart images, diagnostics and interpretation. Local numerical/rendering code makes no separate model call. Reading original data or outputs adds those actual values to host context; no automatic anonymization is applied. Any separately requested publication uses the parent reporting route.
